column1: # Sequential Kalay Colosso tour departure scene and adjacent shop / inn branches.
# Character order, question branches and original end controls unchanged.

column3:
Babi has ruled Tolbi for
over a century. No one
seems to know when he'll{page_break}let someone else take his
place. I wanted to live
somewhere quieter.{end_wait}
Kalay suits me better. I\nhave no wish to go back to\nTolbi.{end_wait}
We'd better hurry, or we'll\nmiss Colosso!{end_wait}
Miss Colosso? Not after\ncoming all this way!{end_wait}
Absolutely not. We came to\nsee the tournament.{end_wait}
We paid for this trip. I\nexpect to get there on\ntime.{end_wait}
Everyone, please. We're\nkeeping to the schedule.{end_wait}
We're only stopping to\ncount the passengers.{end_wait}
Oh. Well, I suppose that's\nsensible.{end_wait}
But if we lose someone, the\nrest of us are the ones\nwaiting.{end_wait}
Then leave them! I want to\nget moving.{end_wait}
Oh, dear. There's no need\nto shout.{end_wait}
Count us, then. Let's get\non with it.{end_wait}
What's the delay? We should\nbe on our way to Tolbi.{end_wait}
Half the group is already\nwaiting by the road.{end_wait}
Why are the guides walking\nback and forth like that?{end_wait}
Silk Road had a landslide.\nNow we have to sail. I paid\nto see Colosso, not to{page_break}spend a day waiting.{end_wait}
What's keeping us? The ship\nwon't wait forever.{end_wait}
No one mentioned a boat\nwhen I bought my ticket. I\ncan't stand being on the{page_break}water.{end_wait}
Ouranos, you'll fight\nanyone at Colosso, but\nyou're afraid to board a{page_break}ship?{end_wait}
I've counted twice. We're\nstill missing one person.{end_wait}
He was at the inn this\nmorning. Where could he\nhave gone?{end_wait}
Who is missing? We've been\nstanding here long enough.{end_wait}
I've never seen so many\npeople make the trip to\nTolbi at once.{end_wait}
Are we really going to hold\neveryone up for one late\ntourist?{end_wait}
I'll bet some of these\npeople are entering\nColosso, not just watching.{end_wait}
I don't like traveling with\nall these strange things\nhappening on the roads.{end_wait}
We told everyone when to\nmeet. This makes us look\nlike fools.{end_wait}
I can't swim. There, I've\nsaid it. What happens if\nthe ship sinks?{end_wait}
I've offered to teach you.\nYou've always found an\nexcuse.{end_wait}
He might still be at the\ninn. I ought to check, but\nthe others are getting{page_break}restless.{end_wait}
Leave now? What about the\nman we're missing?{end_wait}
Everyone was warned. Anyone\nlate would be left behind.{end_wait}
You did tell us that when\nwe bought the tickets.{end_wait}
Then we have to leave. If\nwe miss the ship, nobody\ngets to Tolbi.{end_wait}
Miss the ship? No, no. We\nhave to go!{end_wait}
We've spent enough already.\nWe need to reach Tolbi\nbefore Colosso starts.{end_wait}
I hate leaving him, but\nthere's no time. Let's go.{end_wait}
Finally! Come on, everyone!{end_wait}
Stay together and follow\nme. We don't want to lose\nanyone else.{end_wait}
Where did everyone go? I\ncould've sworn they were\nhere.{end_wait}
They didn't leave without\nme. They wouldn't... would\nthey?{end_wait}
Oh, they did! I'd better\ncatch up!{end_wait}
Then have a look at our\narmor. We have good pieces\nhere too.{end_wait}
So you want the finest\nequipment? We stock good\ngear, but Hammet sends his{page_break}best elsewhere.{end_wait}
You're here for the Tolbi\ntour, aren't you? Colosso\nstarts soon.{end_wait}
A tour to Colosso. Clever\nidea, charging people to\ntravel together. They were{page_break}meeting at the restaurant.{end_wait}
The guest next door looks\nas though he's traveled all\nthe way from Gondowan.{end_wait}
Gondowan lies south of\nAngara. I've heard it's\nenormous, with a warmer{page_break}climate than ours.{end_wait}
